era: PS2 / PSP / PS3 / PS4 / PS5 / PC
summary: Sony Santa Monica's mythic action-adventure series, covering the Greek era, PSP side stories, Norse saga, remasters/collections, and newly announced PS5-era entries.

entries.title: God of War
entries.definitive_edition: God of War Collection on PS3

emulation.notes: Prefer RPCS3 HD remaster; PCSX2 is preservation fallback.

primary.version: God of War Collection / God of War Saga remaster
primary.why: The PS3 remaster runs the PS2 original in HD at 60 fps and is the highest-fidelity official route for the first game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 God of War Collection or God of War Saga version through RPCS3 or original PS3 hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use PS2 original only for exact original-hardware comparison.

entries.title: God of War

primary.why: The 2018 Norse-era God of War released on PS4 and later Windows; PC is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version with current patches.

entries.remaster_caveats: Norse continuity reboot/sequel; do not conflate with the 2005 game of the same title.

entries.title: God of War Ragnarok

primary.why: Ragnarok released on PS4/PS5 and later PC; the PC release is the highest-fidelity route and includes the Valhalla epilogue content path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PC release with current patches.

entries.remaster_caveats: PSN/PC account requirements and regional storefront availability have changed over time; verify current store conditions before purchase.

entries.title: God of War Sons of Sparta
entries.definitive_edition: Digital Deluxe Edition if extras matter; Standard for the game itself

primary.why: Sons of Sparta was released on February 13, 2026 for PS5 and has no other platform route documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS5 digital release; choose Standard or Digital Deluxe depending on whether the art book/soundtrack/avatar extras matter.

entries.remaster_caveats: Released before the current archive date, so it can be assigned a primary route.

entries.title: God of War Laufey

primary.why: God of War Laufey has been announced for PS5, but it is listed as coming soon without a final release date as of June 18, 2026.
primary.how_to_play: Do not assign a definitive route until the game releases and final platform/version details are public.

entries.remaster_caveats: Revisit after release; do not infer a PC route because public sources currently list PS5.

entries.title: God of War Collection

primary.why: This collection remasters God of War and God of War II for PS3 at HD 60 fps and is the best collection route for the first two games.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS3 hardware or RPCS3.

entries.remaster_caveats: Includes only the first two main games.

entries.title: God of War: Origins Collection

primary.why: Origins Collection remasters Chains of Olympus and Ghost of Sparta at native 1080p/60 fps with trophies, rumble, and 3D support.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS3 hardware or RPCS3.

entries.remaster_caveats: Includes only Chains of Olympus and Ghost of Sparta.

entries.title: God of War Saga

emulation.notes: Use PS3 route for disc content.

primary.why: Saga bundles God of War, God of War II, God of War III, Chains of Olympus, and Ghost of Sparta on PS3 discs/download vouchers for a broad Greek-era package.
primary.how_to_play: Use PS3 hardware or RPCS3 for disc content; voucher content availability depends on account/store ownership.

entries.remaster_caveats: God of War III later received a PS4 remaster, so individual entries still give better game-specific picks.

primary.why: The PS4 remaster is the best official version of God of War III and the route recommended for the third Greek mainline game.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS4 or PS5 compatibility.
